## Description
Please include a summary of the changes and the relevant motivation/context.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New tactical feature (non-breaking change adding capability)
- [ ] Security hardening / Patch (Apache HTTPD, Squid, WAF, Cryptographic upgrade)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / Performance improvement

## Quality Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have commented my code where necessary, particularly in complex algorithmic sections
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or lint errors (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] The app builds cleanly for production (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published in downstream modules
- [ ] No API keys, credentials, or confidential operational data are committed
